mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees under clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail with a moderate air quality index of 61. We have a waxing gibbous moon visible, and if you are up early, the ISS will pass overhead tomorrow starting at 5:47 AM, appearing over Cross Plains and tracking toward Madison. The overnight low will be 47 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is gearing up for a Plan Commission meeting on November 4th at 6:30 PM to discuss several proposals, such as the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, residents can look forward to property tax bills arriving by December 15, which can be paid in two installments through the City Treasurer.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market this Saturday.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after responding to reports of dangerous driving. The department confirmed that no injuries were reported during the incident.

Today's featured flavor was Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. As the store is currently closed for the night, we invite you to stop by when we open tomorrow at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
